Sa umaga tayo magkita.","answers":["What time is it?","It is two o’clock.","Class is tomorrow.","Let’s meet in the morning."],"correct":3,"explanation":"Sa umaga tayo magkita. — Let’s meet in the morning.
Ano ang oras? asks for the time. Ala-una is one o’clock; alas-dos is two. Bukas means tomorrow; kahapon means yesterday. Sa can introduce a day or time.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q58","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Lima lahat.","answers":["Just one.","Five in total.","Two pencils, please.","I have brought three books."],"correct":1,"explanation":"Lima lahat. — Five in total.
Isa, dalawa and tatlo mean one, two and three. A linker joins a number to a noun: isang libro, dalawang libro. Mga marks a plural group; many number phrases do not need it.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q63","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Ito ang hinahanap ko.","answers":["My bag is small.","The notebook is blue.","This is what I am looking for.","My book is new."],"correct":2,"explanation":"Ito ang hinahanap ko. — This is what I am looking for.
Adjectives can describe a noun directly: maliit na bag, a small bag; bagong libro, a new book. Na or -ng links the words. Ito is this; iyan is that near the listener.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q69","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Makinig muna.","answers":["Listen first.","Read the question.","Write the answer.","Choose the correct word."],"correct":0,"explanation":"Makinig muna. — Listen first.
Classroom instructions often begin with an action: basahin (read it), isulat (write it), piliin (choose it). Understanding the action word helps you know what an exercise requires.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q75","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Nag-aaral ako pagkatapos ng klase.","answers":["I wake up early.","I attend school every day.","I study after class.","I eat breakfast before leaving."],"correct":2,"explanation":"Nag-aaral ako pagkatapos ng klase. — I study after class.
Tagalog verb forms express aspect. Gumigising and pumapasok can describe repeated actions. A time expression such as araw-araw tells you that the action is habitual.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q80","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Nakita ko ang kaibigan ko.","answers":["Yesterday I went to the shop.","We ate at home.","I bought bread.","I saw my friend."],"correct":3,"explanation":"Nakita ko ang kaibigan ko. — I saw my friend.
Compare kumain, kumakain and kakain: completed, ongoing/habitual and unstarted forms of kain. Kahapon supplies past-time context; the verb form itself marks the action’s aspect.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q86","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Magdadala ako ng pagkain.","answers":["We will go tomorrow.","I will bring food.","What will you do later?","Let’s meet on Saturday."],"correct":1,"explanation":"Magdadala ako ng pagkain. — I will bring food.
Bukas and sa susunod na linggo give future context. Pupunta, gagawin and magdadala describe actions not yet started. Tayo includes the listener; kami does not.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q92","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Saan ko ilalagay ito?","answers":["Why did you leave early?","How will this be done?","When is the submission deadline?","Where will I put this?"],"correct":3,"explanation":"Saan ko ilalagay ito? — Where will I put this?
Saan asks where; bakit asks why; paano asks how. Ba marks a yes/no question and is not a replacement for these question words.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q97","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Mas tahimik dito kaysa roon.","answers":["It is quieter here than there.","I prefer reading.","I like this because it is easy to use.","They are both good."],"correct":0,"explanation":"Mas tahimik dito kaysa roon. — It is quieter here than there.
Mas marks a comparison: mas tahimik, quieter. Kaysa introduces what you compare it with. Dahil gives a reason. Gusto can mean like or want; context matters.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q103","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Hindi malinaw sa akin ang panuto.","answers":["Could you explain it again, please?","Which part should I do first?","The instruction is not clear to me.","Could I borrow a pencil?"],"correct":2,"explanation":"Hindi malinaw sa akin ang panuto. — The instruction is not clear to me.
Puwede po bang…? makes a respectful request. A specific request is easier to answer than a general statement that you do not understand. Huwag introduces a negative command.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q109","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Lumiko ka sa kanan.","answers":["Turn right.","Go straight first.","It is beside the library.","The shop is opposite the school."],"correct":0,"explanation":"Lumiko ka sa kanan. — Turn right.
Dumiretso, lumiko and tumawid are useful route instructions. Bago and pagkatapos can order steps. Sa tapat ng means opposite; sa tabi ng means beside.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q115","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Hindi pa ako tapos.","answers":["The meeting time has changed.","I am outside now.","I am not finished yet.","Please tell the others."],"correct":2,"explanation":"Hindi pa ako tapos. — I am not finished yet.
A short message should make who, what and when easy to find. Na signals a change in state in many contexts; pa can show that something is still true or still needed.","image":null,"difficulty":1},{"id":"q120","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Nagbabasa ako nang dumating siya.","answers":["At first, I did not notice him or her.","While we were waiting, the rain began.","In the end, the problem was resolved.","I was reading when he or she arrived."],"correct":3,"explanation":"Nagbabasa ako nang dumating siya. — I was reading when he or she arrived.
Use an ongoing form for background and a completed action for an event: Nagbabasa ako nang dumating siya. Nang can introduce when an event occurred. Keep the time reference consistent.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q126","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Hindi ako nakapasok dahil may sakit ako.","answers":["It is raining, so the game was postponed.","I could not attend because I was ill.","Although it was difficult, we still tried.","If we leave early, we will make it."],"correct":1,"explanation":"Hindi ako nakapasok dahil may sakit ako. — I could not attend because I was ill.
Dahil introduces a cause; kaya introduces a result. Bagaman introduces a concession. Do not treat a sequence of events as proof that one event caused another.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q132","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Sumulat si Ana ng liham.","answers":["He or she gave it to the teacher.","The message is about the project.","How are you?","Ana wrote a letter."],"correct":3,"explanation":"Sumulat si Ana ng liham. — Ana wrote a letter.
Compare Sumulat si Ana ng liham and Isinulat ni Ana ang liham. Both can concern Ana writing a letter, but the verb form and markers organize the sentence differently. Ang/si, ng/ni and sa mark different roles; they are not freely interchangeable.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q137","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Compare Sumulat si Ana ng liham and Isinulat ni Ana ang liham. Both can concern Ana writing a letter, but the verb form and markers organize the sentence differently. Ang/si, ng/ni and sa mark different roles; they are not freely interchangeable.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q143","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Hindi kailangang isama ang lahat ng detalye.","answers":["The main idea is clear.","In short, we need a plan.","Not every detail needs to be included.","According to the text, there are two reasons."],"correct":2,"explanation":"Hindi kailangang isama ang lahat ng detalye. — Not every detail needs to be included.
A buod keeps the central idea and essential details. Paksa means topic; pangunahing ideya is the main idea. Examples support the main idea but do not all belong in a short summary.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q149","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Ito ang dahilan ng pananaw ko.","answers":["This is the reason for my view.","In my opinion, this will help.","According to the record, more people attended.","I agree with the suggestion."],"correct":0,"explanation":"Ito ang dahilan ng pananaw ko. — This is the reason for my view.
Sa palagay ko signals a personal view. A factual claim can in principle be checked, even if it turns out to be wrong. An opinion also needs reasons when you use it in an argument.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q154","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Tinanong ko kung totoo ang balita.","answers":["According to Mina, the library is open.","I asked whether the news was true.","He or she said that he or she would come.","The meeting is reportedly tomorrow."],"correct":1,"explanation":"Tinanong ko kung totoo ang balita. — I asked whether the news was true.
Ayon kay introduces a named source; ayon sa introduces a text or organization. Daw/raw can mark reported information. Reporting someone’s claim does not automatically establish that it is true.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q160","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Nagbago ang pasiya niya sa huli.","answers":["Who is the main character?","Where and when did the story take place?","What problem does the character face?","His or her decision changed at the end."],"correct":3,"explanation":"Nagbago ang pasiya niya sa huli. — His or her decision changed at the end.
Tauhan means character, tagpuan means setting, and tunggalian means conflict. A theme is an idea developed through events; it is not simply a list of characters or a plot summary.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q166","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Maaari nating alisin ang pag-uulit.","answers":["First, the topic needs to be clear.","We can remove the repetition.","In addition, an example matters.","The next detail is related to this."],"correct":1,"explanation":"Maaari nating alisin ang pag-uulit. — We can remove the repetition.
A paragraph needs a controlling idea, related support and a useful ending. Una, bukod dito and samakatuwid help connections, but adding connectors cannot repair unrelated ideas.","image":null,"difficulty":2},{"id":"q172","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Mahalagang isaalang-alang ang ibang pananaw.","answers":["I suggest trying the plan first.","This proposal has an adequate basis.","However, this method has a limitation.","It is important to consider another perspective."],"correct":3,"explanation":"Mahalagang isaalang-alang ang ibang pananaw. — It is important to consider another perspective.
A strong argument connects a claim to relevant evidence. Gayunman marks a qualification; samakatuwid introduces a conclusion. A confident tone is not evidence by itself.","image":null,"difficulty":3},{"id":"q177","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Hindi nangangahulugang wala nang ibang pagpipilian.","answers":["That does not mean there are no other choices.","I understand your concern.","We can combine the two proposals.","The question is how this will be implemented."],"correct":0,"explanation":"Hindi nangangahulugang wala nang ibang pagpipilian. — That does not mean there are no other choices.
Bagaman concedes a point; sa kabilang banda introduces another side. Refuting a weaker invented position does not answer the actual concern. State the concern fairly before responding.","image":null,"difficulty":3},{"id":"q183","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Masyadong malawak ang pahayag.","answers":["Who is the target reader?","What does it want the reader to do?","The claim is too broad.","The word used is persuasive."],"correct":2,"explanation":"Masyadong malawak ang pahayag. — The claim is too broad.
A persuasive text selects language for an audience and a purpose. Words such as lahat and tiyak can imply more certainty than the evidence supports. Ask what information is missing.","image":null,"difficulty":3},{"id":"q189","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Sakaling hindi siya dumating, tayo ang magsisimula.","answers":["If he or she does not arrive, we will start.","If I had known, I could have prepared.","Their decision may change.","This will not happen without permission."],"correct":0,"explanation":"Sakaling hindi siya dumating, tayo ang magsisimula. — If he or she does not arrive, we will start.
Kung introduces conditions. Sana and conditional forms can express an unreal past: Kung nalaman ko, nakapaghanda sana ako. Distinguish a possibility from a statement of fact.","image":null,"difficulty":3},{"id":"q194","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

May iba pang posibleng pagbasa.","answers":["The door may symbolize a new opportunity.","Another reading is possible.","The character’s action supports this.","The narrator did not state it directly."],"correct":1,"explanation":"May iba pang posibleng pagbasa. — Another reading is possible.
A literary response needs a claim, a detail and an explanation of the connection. A symbol is interpreted in context; it does not have one fixed meaning in every story.","image":null,"difficulty":3},{"id":"q200","prompt":"What does this mean in English?

Ipinababatid namin ang pagbabago sa iskedyul.","answers":["I would like to ask for clarification, respectfully.","Could the deadline be extended, please?","Please take a look at this when you have time.","We are informing you of the schedule change."],"correct":3,"explanation":"Ipinababatid namin ang pagbabago sa iskedyul. — We are informing you of the schedule change.
Register depends on audience, purpose and relationship. A formal message is clear and respectful, not merely longer. A familiar message can be concise without being careless.","image":null,"difficulty":3},{"id":"q206","prompt":"What does this mean in English?
